name: Jupiter
whatItDoes: Solana's premier swap aggregator that routes trades across multiple DEXs to find the best execution price.
watchOutFor: High slippage on low-liquidity pairs or volatile meme coins.

name: Raydium
whatItDoes: An on-chain AMM and liquidity provider integrated with the Solana ecosystem.
watchOutFor: Impermanent loss when providing liquidity in high-volatility pairs.

name: Orca
whatItDoes: A leading user-friendly DEX specializing in concentrated liquidity Whirlpools.
watchOutFor: Positions going out of range and stopping fee accrual.

name: Kamino Finance
whatItDoes: A unified DeFi platform offering lending, borrowing, and automated vault liquidity management.
watchOutFor: Liquidation risk if collateral value drops below liquidation thresholds.

name: Solscan
whatItDoes: A block explorer providing transparent analytics, transaction histories, and token holder details on Solana.
watchOutFor: Fake mimic tokens with identical symbols; always verify the mint address.

name: Phantom
whatItDoes: A popular self-custody crypto wallet available as a browser extension and mobile app.
watchOutFor: Never share your 12-word seed phrase or click unknown dapp links.

name: Drift Protocol
whatItDoes: A decentralized perpetual futures exchange on Solana offering leverage, funding rates, and cross-margin trading.
watchOutFor: Leverage and liquidation risk - a small adverse move can wipe an over-leveraged position.

name: Wormhole
whatItDoes: A cross-chain messaging and asset-transfer bridge connecting Solana to many other chains.
watchOutFor: Bridges are the most-exploited category in DeFi; a compromised mint can depeg the wrapped asset.

name: Pump.fun
whatItDoes: A fair-launch platform where anyone can create a memecoin that trades on a bonding curve and graduates to a DEX.
watchOutFor: Almost all launches go to zero; snipers and rugs take retail's money. Assume any deposit is fully at risk.

name: Jito
whatItDoes: Provides liquid staking plus a block-engine and tips system on Solana, giving traders a way to route and prioritize transactions.
watchOutFor: Priority tips cost real SOL; paying more for inclusion does not by itself protect you from being sandwiched.

name: DexScreener
whatItDoes: A multi-chain DEX charting tool showing price, liquidity, volume, and transaction activity for thousands of token pairs.
watchOutFor: Liquidity can be pulled at any moment; a good chart does not mean a safe token.

name: Solana Explorer
whatItDoes: The official Solana Labs block explorer for viewing any transaction, account, program, or token mint, including a mint's live mint and freeze authority settings.
watchOutFor: Mind the cluster toggle (Mainnet vs Devnet) - a token can look clean on the wrong network.

name: RugCheck
whatItDoes: A Solana token safety scanner that reports mint and freeze authority status, LP lock or burn, holder concentration, and top-holder distribution as a fast pre-trade red-flag check.
watchOutFor: A clean score is a starting filter, not an audit - it cannot see off-chain rug plans.
